mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact Python/browser catalogue agreement at n=0..63 for 26 entries; reciprocal rational-series oracle at N=2..8, r=1..3, n=0..15; Bell/Fubini recurrences through n=31; second differences of squares through n=63 and signed fixtures; successive modular coordinates for negative and above-2^53 integers; query parsing, wildcard offsets, sorting, deep links and storage fixtures.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact integers and rational values; plot coordinates approximate
mathematics.conventions: Compressed index starts at zero; reciprocal ordinary degree N*n; least nonnegative residues; second differences undefined before index two; adjacent-residue points need the next integer-valued sample; query signs retained.
